newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian ministries feud over NNPC payments.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian ministries feud over NNPC payments.

text.p: Nigeria's finance and oil ministries are in strong disagreement over who should receive budget payments for Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) projects, a senior oil ministry official said on Friday.

The official said the finance ministry had witheld approval from the central bank to transfer 12 billion naira ($145 million) from this year's capital budget to NNPC and intended to pay contractors to the state oil company directly.

"We have been told that the ministry of finance wants to take up payment of NNPC contractors and that is why the money has been witheld," he said. "We are challenging that decision and we hope to settle the issue by Tuesday."

Petroleum minister Dan Etete on Wednesday said the ministry had received money from the finance ministry which would be used for turnaround maintenance of ailing refineries -- operating well below their 445,000 barrels per day capacity.
Etete and finance minister Anthony Ani publicly criticised each other last month over the release of funds to the oil industry.
